english: I want to buy a notebook.
Tomorrow I will go to school.
I need to call my teacher and send the homework.
french: Je dois appeler mon professeur et envoyer les devoirs.
kinyarwanda_draft_needs_native_review: Ngomba guhamagara mwarimu no kohereza umukoro.

english: Tomorrow I need to call my school, prepare my CV, buy a notebook and practise piano.
french: Demain je dois appeler mon école, préparer mon CV, acheter un cahier et pratiquer le piano.
kinyarwanda_draft_needs_native_review: Ejo ngomba guhamagara ishuri, gutegura CV yanjye, kugura ikaye no kwitoza piano.

english: Remind me to call mum tomorrow at nine in the morning.
french: Rappelle-moi d'appeler maman demain à neuf heures du matin.
kinyarwanda_draft_needs_native_review: Unyibutse guhamagara mama ejo saa tatu za mu gitondo.

english: Remind me on Friday to pay the rent.
french: Rappelle-moi vendredi de payer le loyer.
kinyarwanda_draft_needs_native_review: Ku wa gatanu unyibutse kwishyura ubukode.

english: Remind me later to drink water.
french: Rappelle-moi plus tard de boire de l'eau.

english: On Friday I have a maths exam at two in the afternoon.
french: Vendredi j'ai un examen de maths à quatorze heures.
kinyarwanda_draft_needs_native_review: Ku wa gatanu mfite ikizamini cy'imibare saa munani z'amanywa.

english: Next Monday there is a family meeting at my uncle's house, I must bring food and call my cousins before.
french: Lundi prochain il y a une réunion de famille chez mon oncle, je dois apporter de la nourriture et appeler mes cousins avant.
kinyarwanda_draft_needs_native_review: Ku wa mbere utaha hari inama y'umuryango kwa data wacu, ngomba kuzana ibiryo no guhamagara babyara banjye mbere.

english: My idea is to open a small shop selling phone chargers near the bus station, because many travellers need them.
french: Mon idée est d'ouvrir une petite boutique de chargeurs de téléphone près de la gare routière, car beaucoup de voyageurs en ont besoin.
kinyarwanda_draft_needs_native_review: Igitekerezo cyanjye ni ugufungura iduka rito ricuruza chargeurs za telefoni hafi ya gare, kuko abagenzi benshi bazikenera.

english: My sister's birthday is on the twelfth of March.
french: L'anniversaire de ma sœur est le douze mars.
kinyarwanda_draft_needs_native_review: Isabukuru y'amavuko ya mushiki wanjye ni ku itariki ya cumi n'ebyiri Werurwe.

english: (mixed) Tomorrow I must call the school then go to the meeting at two.
french: (mélange) Demain je dois appeler l'école puis aller à la réunion à deux heures.
kinyarwanda_draft_needs_native_review: Ejo ngomba guhamagara école, hanyuma nkajya kuri meeting saa munani.

english: (mixed) Remind me to send the report to my boss before Friday.
french: (mélange) Rappelle-moi d'envoyer le rapport à mon chef avant vendredi.
kinyarwanda_draft_needs_native_review: Unyibutse kohereza rapport kwa boss wanjye mbere ya vendredi.

english: Call Jean-Paul on 0788 123 456 about the 25000 franc payment.
french: Appelle Jean-Paul au 0788 123 456 pour le paiement de 25000 francs.
kinyarwanda_draft_needs_native_review: Hamagara Jean-Paul kuri 0788 123 456 ku bijyanye no kwishyura amafaranga ibihumbi makumyabiri na bitanu.

english: (free) Describe your plans for this week in your own words for about 30 seconds.
french: (libre) Décrivez vos projets de la semaine avec vos propres mots pendant environ 30 secondes.
kinyarwanda_draft_needs_native_review: (speaker's own words — no script) Vuga gahunda zawe z'iki cyumweru mu masegonda nka 30.
